subject.title: [Feature]: Integrate password toggle functionality across all platforms to let users see password in clear text

question: Should sensitive-input visibility always reset to masked on navigation or relaunch, or may any platform persist a user's clear-text visibility preference?
rationale: The implementation mechanics are standard, but persistence changes the shoulder-surfing and accidental-disclosure posture and cannot be selected safely from code evidence alone.

options.title: Ephemeral reveal
options.body: Keep every sensitive field masked by default and reset visibility when the field, view, or app lifecycle ends.

options.title: Session-scoped reveal
options.body: Allow visibility to survive navigation within one active app session but reset on reload or relaunch.

options.title: Persistent preference
options.body: Persist visibility across reloads or launches, accepting the increased accidental-disclosure risk.

recommendation.title: Ephemeral reveal
recommendation.body: Keep every sensitive field masked by default and reset visibility when the field, view, or app lifecycle ends.
